summary: Standard Base64 alphabet encoder: maps a 6-bit index in [0,63] to its ASCII character. Index ranges 0-25 map to 'A'-'Z' (index+65), 26-51 to 'a'-'z' (index+71), 52-61 to '0'-'9' (index-4), 62 to '+', and 63 to '/'. Any index >= 64 returns 0 (no valid mapping). Called by Base64Encode (00562090) and by PadOutputWithSpacesUpToLengthLimit (00564B80).

local_names.a1: Base64 6-bit index (0..63) to convert to an ASCII character

operations.description: Guard on a1 < 26 (0x1A); first range of the alphabet.
Return a1 + 65, mapping indices 0-25 to ASCII 'A'-'Z'.
Guard on a1 < 52 (0x34); second range of the alphabet.
Return a1 + 71, mapping indices 26-51 to ASCII 'a'-'z'.
Return a1 - 4, mapping indices 52-61 to ASCII '0'-'9'.
Final fallback: return 47 (0x2F), the ASCII '/', when a1 == 63, otherwise return 0 for any out-of-range index.
Invoked by Base64Encode (00562090) to encode each 6-bit group, and by PadOutputWithSpacesUpToLengthLimit (00564B80).

unresolved: The return 0 path for a1 >= 64 is dead for well-formed Base64 input (only 64 index values exist); its purpose in the caller context is unverified.
Why PadOutputWithSpacesUpToLengthLimit (00564B80) invokes the alphabet encoder is unclear from this packet; the caller's padding semantics are not reconstructed here.
